description: Change the REAL OS permission for the connected app from this machine, for what an in-app override can't fake (native code that checks the OS itself, like reading a position or opening the camera). iOS Simulator uses `xcrun simctl privacy` (grant, revoke, reset; reset returns to 'not asked' so the real prompt shows again). There is no simctl service for notifications or tracking. Android uses `adb shell pm grant/revoke`; reset also clears 'don't ask again'. Revoking or resetting ends the app's process on both platforms, so relaunch it afterwards. Physical iPhones can't be changed this way.

action.description: grant, revoke, or reset to not asked.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

permission.description: location, locationBackground, camera, microphone, notifications, photos, contacts, calendar, reminders, tracking, motion, bluetooth, or all.

serial.description: Android: the adb serial, when several devices are connected.

udid.description: iOS: the simulator udid, when its name is ambiguous.

name: system_permission
